name: Uzuki Nayuta
source:
Likes: Black coffee, taking care of others
Dislikes: Sweet foods

Shun's good friend who is the student council president and one of the only girls he can interact with normally. She is great at taking care of others but has a hard time taking care of herself. Nayuta loves romance dramas and manga and often wishes for the same kind of romance in her life.
